in_sanskrit.name: मेघनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lord of the Clouds, the monsoon god, Indra in his cloud form.

in_marathi.name: Meghnath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Meghnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Meghnath is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Megha' meaning cloud and 'Nath' meaning lord. It refers to a deity who controls the clouds and rain. This name is mentioned in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring prosperity and abundance.
